questions.question: Rohit donates 15% of his monthly income to charity funds. The remaining income is spent in the following manner: 35% on food, 20% on rent, 17% on bills, 8% on clothing, and the remaining is kept as savings. If the amount saved each month is ₹14,620, then what is Rohit's monthly income?
questions.solution:
Let us consider Rohit income as 100%

Rohit donates 15% of his monthly income to charity funds → 100% - 15% = 85%

The remaining income of Rohit = 85%

Let us consider this 85% of total income = X/-

In remaining income, Rohit spent 35% on food, 20% on rent, 17% on bills, 8% on clothing = 35 + 20 + 17 + 8 = 80%

Expenses of Rohit = 80% of X

Savings of Rohit = 20% of X

The amount saved each month is ₹14,620 by Rohit → 20% × X = 14620

⇒ (20/100) × X = 14620

⇒ (1/5) × X = 14620

⇒ X = 73100/-

∴ As, we considered 85% of total income = X/-

Here, 85% of total income = 73100/-

⇒ 100% of total income = 100 × (73100/85)

⇒ 100% of total income = 100 × 860

∴ Total monthly income of Rohit = 86000/-

Hence, the correct answer is **"₹86,000".**

questions.question: Which of the following diseases is caused by a virus transmitted primarily by Aedes mosquitoes?
questions.solution:

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Zika fever is caused by a virus transmitted primarily by Aedes mosquitoes.

 
• Zika virus is primarily transmitted by the bite of an infected mosquito from the Aedes genus, mainly Aedes aegypti, in tropical and subtropical regions.
 
 
• Aedes mosquitoes usually bite during the day, peaking during early morning and late afternoon/evening.
 
• This is the same mosquito that transmits dengue, chikungunya and yellow fever.
 
 
 
• The incubation period (the time from exposure to symptoms) of Zika virus disease is estimated to be 3–14 days.
 
• The majority of people infected with Zika virus do not develop symptoms.
 
 
• Symptoms are generally mild including fever, rash, conjunctivitis, muscle and joint pain, malaise, and headache, and usually last for 2–7 days.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Minamata disease **is a disease of the central nervous system, a poisoning caused by long-term consumption, in large amounts, of fish and shellfish from Minamata Bay.
 
 
• The causative agent is** methylmercury.**
